description: A Pfam family entry identified by a PF accession. SPOKE calls these entries ProteinDomain, while Pfam calls them families; Pfam families typically define conserved domains or motifs. Entries with and without a Pfam clan assignment are represented. Clan-assigned entries have a membership relationship to a ProteinFamily node, which represents the Pfam clan.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: Pfam family accession as a full CURIE, such as Pfam:PF00001.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Family description from Pfam, used as the primary human-readable label.

common_properties.name: entryName
common_properties.description: Short family name from Pfam, such as 7tm_1.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this entry; Pfam contributes the value Pfam.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp when the node was created or its properties changed.

source_contributions.scope: Pfam family entries with a PF accession in the Pfam clan-membership release, including families that have no clan assignment. This contribution describes the family/clan taxonomy, rather than protein-to-family assignments.
source_contributions.description: Pfam supplies family accessions, descriptive labels and short names. Its PF family terminology corresponds to ProteinDomain in SPOKE; CL clans correspond to ProteinFamily.
